quotations.sentIntro: Check the status and seller response for your custom furniture requests.
quotations.receivedIntro: Review the requested dimensions and send a proposal or explain why you cannot make it.
quotations.empty: There are no quotation requests yet.
quotations.loadFailed: We could not load the request. Check your connection and access permissions.
quotations.studioIntro: Adjust the dimensions, compare them with the published model and request a quotation from the seller.
quotations.diagramNotice: Illustrative diagram of the requested dimensions. Shape, feasibility and finish require seller confirmation.
quotations.photoNotice: The photo shows the published model; it does not change when dimensions are adjusted.
quotations.priceNotice: The published price applies to the original dimensions. The seller will confirm feasibility, price and production time for your request.
quotations.range: Values between {min} and {max} {unit}, with up to 3 decimal places.
quotations.invalidDimension: Enter a valid dimension within the permitted range.
quotations.notes: Tell the seller what you need
quotations.notesHelp: Optional. Up to {max} characters. Do not include payment information.
quotations.notesTooLong: The message exceeds the permitted length.
quotations.contactNotice: The seller will receive this email with your dimensions and enquiry.
quotations.login: Sign in to request a quotation
quotations.sendFailed: We could not send the request. Your dimensions are preserved so you can retry.
quotations.productChanged: The product conditions have changed. Refresh the product before sending your request.
quotations.selfRequest: This product belongs to your store. Your customers can request a quotation here.
quotations.confirmedNotice: Your request was saved and is available to the seller. Check its status and response in My quotations.
quotations.awaiting: The seller has not responded yet. You can check the status here later.
quotations.quoteNotice: Seller proposal for this request. A quotation does not confirm a purchase or reserve stock. Shipping is agreed separately.
quotations.quoteOption: I can make it · send quotation
quotations.priceHelp: Use the currency of this request: {currency}.
quotations.responseHelp: Confirm your proposal details or explain why you cannot make it.
quotations.invalidPrice: Enter a positive price with no more than 2 decimal places.
quotations.invalidDays: Enter positive whole days. The maximum must be equal to or greater than the minimum.
quotations.messageRequired: Write a message for the customer.
quotations.responseFinal: Review the details before sending. Your response will be saved for the customer.
quotations.responseFailed: We could not save the response. Check the details and try again.
quotations.alreadyAnswered: This request has already been answered. Refresh to check its status.
quotations.notifications: New requests and responses appear here when you refresh the list.
